2026-10-28-archer-deep.purpose: Are grade-3 archers behind drifters the Knife's hardest ordinary batch, hit while closing in?
2026-10-28-archer-deep.play: Press Dive, play the gate until it is cleared or you die; the tag says done. Don't press R.
measures: hits by archer and by drifter
distance to the nearest archer at each shot taken

hits by what and how soon after a change
its burst at the screen edge

measures: the mini-boss's lunges thrown and landed, in order

the lowest HP of the dive, and where it ends

HP after each gate; the lowest HP of the dive
time a gate and a layer; the bosses' times
dashes and shots a gate: how much the guard lets you stand and swing
compared gate by gate with suit-off: same seed, same batches
